title: The pulse starts today: no check-ins yet
detail: WS-07 is daily from today. As of 08:40 UTC no one has a file in people/<id>/pulse/. Two minutes with your agent (or typed) after the stand-up: people/<you>/pulse/2026-11-03-midday.md, the six questions on the start page. The pulse agent reads them at 13:10 and 19:40.
